digest:
- AM Best reports that social inflation and litigation continue to surge, driving up commercial auto liability claim costs faster than general inflation. This underscores the need for our telematics-based MGA to leverage real-time data for risk selection and driver exoneration [10].
- ShipMatrix forecasts a 4% year-over-year increase in parcel shipping demand for the upcoming holiday peak season. Higher parcel volumes mean more delivery vans on the road, temporarily increasing exposure for our insured fleets [2].
- Major retailers and Amazon reported higher shipping and freight costs in the third quarter alongside isolated inventory delays. This reflects broader retail logistics spending that can influence fleet operational margins [3].
